planets.name: TOI-1691 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1691 with a 16.7-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1691 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1691. Its orbit and size follow Crossfield et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
